summary: Backend-only verification of FIL BUY-fee bug fix (Binance charges 0.1% in base asset). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_fee_fix_and_regression.py — 14 pytest cases, ALL PASS. Coverage: (A) FIX 1 _parse_fill directly imported and unit tested: (1) FIL fills qty=4.57 commission=0.00457 commissionAsset=FIL base_asset='FIL' -> net 4.56543, quote 4.995924, avg 1.0932 (exact reported bug), (2) commissionAsset='BNB' with BNB fee discount -> qty stays 4.57 (not netted), (3) SELL path base_asset='' -> gross qty returned (USDT fee not subtracted from base), (4) multi-fill aggregation with FIL commission, (5) fallback to executedQty/cummulativeQuoteQty when no fills. (B) FIX 2 LOT_SIZE floor math: 4.56543/0.01 -> 4.56; 0.005/0.01 -> 0 (caller raises 'No sellable balance'). (C) FIX 3 dust reset math: tracked 4.57 - sold 4.56 = 0.01 < step*1.05 (0.0105) -> 0 (cycle reset); non-dust 2.57 remainder preserved. (D) Demo regression on preview: /api/ returns {app:'Trade Skill',status:'ok'}, admin login works, GET /api/bots, GET /api/wallet/summary, GET /api/market/top all 200, POST /api/bots/SOLUSDT/start then /stop respond with expected codes. Code review of LIVE path (server.py:1220-1260) confirms _parse_fill called with base_asset only on BUY, SELL clamps to Binance free balance then floors to LOT_SIZE step, dust reset in SELL block at line 1291-1313 increments cycles_completed and resets margin_call_count.
critical_code_review_comments: _parse_fill (server.py:1103): correctly guards with `if base_asset:` so SELL calls (base_asset='') never mis-subtract USDT commission. Uses f.get('commission', 0) so missing fee key doesn't crash. max(0.0, qty - base_comm) prevents negative. Good.

_execute_trade LIVE SELL (server.py:1236-1248): clamp to Binance get_asset_balance().free wrapped in try/except -> if RPC fails, tracked qty used as-is (acceptable fallback). LOT_SIZE floor uses math.floor(qty/step + 1e-9) which protects against float rounding (e.g. 4.56/0.01 = 455.9999...). qty<=0 raises 400 'No sellable balance on Binance' — matches the reported UI warning path.

Dust reset (server.py:1293-1295): uses _LOT_STEP_CACHE.get(symbol, 0.000001) — CAUTION: SELL side doesn't await _get_lot_step (only BUY does, indirectly). If a bot has never done a BUY on that symbol via the live path, the LOT_SIZE cache would be empty on first SELL, falling back to 0.000001 → dust threshold ~1.05e-6 → real dust like 0.01 FIL would NOT be reset and would appear as tiny leftover position. Recommend: `step = await _get_lot_step(client, symbol)` at the start of the SELL settle block (line ~1289) instead of reading cache. Not blocking for typical flow (BUY populates cache before SELL) but hardens edge case (bot restart between BUY and SELL clears in-memory _LOT_STEP_CACHE).

cycles_completed increment (line 1312): only when reset==True (remaining_qty==0). If Binance dust remains slightly ABOVE step*1.05 due to price/fee edge case, cycle won't advance — user would see 'stuck' bot. Suggest logging remaining_qty at INFO level in SELL branch so ops can diagnose.

_parse_fill returns avg from gross qty (before commission subtraction) — correct because avg should be trade price, not cost-basis-per-received-coin. Downstream new_avg = new_amt/new_qty (line 1266) uses NET qty which slightly inflates avg_price by fee%, meaning take-profit target is on net-qty basis — correct for computing realized profit.
seed_data_creation: None. SOLUSDT bot was started+stopped during regression; verified /stop returned OK to avoid leaving bot active.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fee-fix (base_asset commission netted on BUY) verified end-to-end via direct import of _parse_fill from server.py. LIVE Binance path cannot be exercised in preview (no API keys, US IP block) but math and code structure are sound. Only nit: SELL settle reads _LOT_STEP_CACHE directly instead of awaiting _get_lot_step — edge case on cold cache. Preview demo regression clean.
rca of the issue: Reported bug: bot buys FIL, Binance charges 0.1% fee in FIL (0.00457 out of 4.57), so wallet actually holds 4.56543 while bot's DB position_qty=4.57. Later at +2.26% take-profit, SELL tries qty=4.57 → Binance rejects 'insufficient balance / shortfall 0.00457 FIL'. Fix: (1) _parse_fill now subtracts fills[*].commission where commissionAsset==base_asset (only on BUY, base_asset param passed); (2) as defence-in-depth, SELL path clamps qty to actual Binance free balance and floors to LOT_SIZE step; (3) any sub-step dust after successful SELL is treated as 0, cycle counter increments and margin_call_count resets so next cycle starts clean. All three verified via 14 pytest cases + code review.
